magnet.note: Metal fridge magnet (Sorakara-chan, Tokyo Skytree). Outline is the front silhouette, upright (tower up), centred on its bounding box, metres, y-up, CCW.

front_texture.note: front art as seen from the front; pixel (cx,cy) = outline bbox centre; +x right, image y down. Alpha = silhouette.

back_texture.note: Original photo retained. Projective UV registration from mirrored front pixel frame to back photo, fitted to 15 silhouette landmarks; actual rubber inset excludes photographed metal rim. No fill texture.

magnet.outline_note: Photo-traced front silhouette, with the tower/star and star/cloud concave cuts restored from the photograph; distances and thickness remain estimates.

card.note: Folded paperboard backing card. One sheet folded at the BOTTOM edge: front panel (light-blue print, die-cut window) and back panel (white, info/barcode, round peek hole). Blister flange sandwiched between panels, bubble pokes out of the window.

back_outside_texture.note: Original IMG_0507 photograph retained; inverse registration removes photographed fabric above the bent top edge and maps the paper to a flat panel. The real die-cut hole remains geometric.

photo_registration.method_note: Ruled surface inverse map follows manually checked paper edges and the photographed hole ellipse. The clipped, unprinted upper-left margin uses the first visible paper pixels. No ink, lettering, logos or barcode are repainted.

inside_front_texture.note: inside of front panel as seen when the card is opened (white with window). placeholder until final

inside_back_texture.note: inside of back panel (warning text, hole). placeholder until final

card.window_frame: front panel frame: origin at bottom-left corner of the front panel viewed from the front, fold line = bottom edge, x right, y up, metres

peek_hole.note: measured on back panel outside view (read from behind)

blister.note: Clear PET blister: flat flange (rounded rectangle) + raised bubble following the magnet outline.
blister.placement: flange centred on the magnet centre; magnet sits in the bubble face-forward; bubble protrudes through the card window toward the viewer

bag.note: OPP header bag. Printed white header at top with round hang hole; heat-seal band with serrated texture; transparent body; self-adhesive flap at the bottom end on the back side (open by peeling it).

header_front_texture.note: 76 x 29.5 mm printed header (front), alpha = hang hole

bag.card_position: card centred horizontally, card top edge ~2 mm below the seal band, card front facing the bag front
